scanNote:
WORKBOOK 1-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (6-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '1' va 'People around the World'.

CHAP USTUN:
11) 'Look at the picture below, then use the prompts to make sentences about Bill, as in the examples.' KATTA RASM (Billning xonasi): javonlarda ko'p kitoblar, devorda samolyot surati va xarita/poster, karavot, deraza, televizor va musiqa markazi (stereo), gitara, molbertda chizilayotgan surat (odam sharpasi), bo'yoqlar, basketbol to'pi, gilamda mushuk. Kompyuter, pianino, telefon, it YO'Q.
  1 paint/pictures ...Bill paints pictures.... 2 play/tennis ...Bill doesn't play tennis.... 3 have/a cat, 4 use/a computer, 5 have/posters on the wall, 6 like/reading, 7 have/piano lessons, 8 have/a telephone, 9 listen to/music, 10 have/a dog.
12) 'Tick the correct sentences.' 1 a) Anna is painting pictures in her free time. b) Anna paints pictures in her free time. 2 a) I am driving my son to school every day. b) I drive my son to school every day. 3 a) Steve is playing tennis at the moment. b) Steve plays tennis at the moment. 4 a) Jill watches TV every weekend. b) Jill is watching TV every weekend. 5 a) Mum cooks dinner at the moment. b) Mum is cooking dinner at the moment. 6 a) He phones his friend right now. b) He is phoning his friend right now.

O'NG USTUN:
13) 'Look at the pictures and prompts, then make sentences, as in the example.' Qiya: 'have a shave, work out at the gym, take a taxi to work, cycle to work, have breakfast, wash the car'. Jadval USUALLY / TODAY, 3 qator rasm: 1 Kim nonushta qilyapti / sport zalida gantel ko'taryapti: 'Kim usually has breakfast at 8:00 on Saturday morning, but today she ........ .' 2 Paul soqol olyapti / mashina yuvyapti: 'Paul usually ........ after breakfast, but today he ........ .' 3 Karen velosipedda / taksiga chiqyapti: 'Karen usually ........ in the morning, but today she ........ .'
• 'Communication: Getting to Know People' (to'q sariq doira).
14) 'Use the sentences to complete the dialogue.' Qiya ro'yxat: Really? Where in Spain? / Julio? How do you spell that? / Yes, it is. / Yes, I do. It's lovely. DIALOG: R: Hello. Is this your first day here? J: 1) ...... R: I'm Rick. What's your name? J: My name's Julio. R: 2) ...... J: J - U - L - I - O. R: Where are you from? J: I'm from Spain. R: 3) ...... J: I'm from Barcelona. R: Do you like it here in London? J: 4) ......

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '6'.

exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - TASDIQ va INKOR
  (3-shaxs).

  TASDIQ: Bill + fe'l + S
    'Bill paints pictures.'
  INKOR: Bill + DOESN'T + fe'l
    'Bill doesn't play tennis.'
  ⚠ Inkorda fe'lga -S QO'ShILMAYDI!


RASMDA NIMA BOR / YO'Q:

  BOR: molbert va bo'yoqlar (chizadi),
    mushuk, devorda suratlar
    (samolyot, xarita), ko'p
    kitoblar, musiqa markazi va
    gitara
  YO'Q: tennis raketkasi, kompyuter,
    pianino, telefon, it

  ⚠ Basketbol to'pi bor, lekin
  ro'yxatda basketbol yo'q.


⚠ 'TO HAVE PIANO LESSONS':

  = pianino darsiga bormoq.
  'have lessons' = dars olmoq.


⚠ 'TO LISTEN TO MUSIC':

  'listen' dan keyin HAR DOIM 'TO'.

exercises.exampleUz: Bill surat chizadi. / Bill tennis o'ynamaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
SIMPLE yoki CONTINUOUS - KALIT
  SO'ZLARGA QARANG:

  SIMPLE (odatiy):
    in her free time, every day,
    every weekend
  CONTINUOUS (hozir):
    at the moment, right now


⚠ XATO GAPLAR NEGA XATO:

  1a 'is painting ... in her free
     time' - odat → simple kerak
  2a 'am driving ... every day' -
     odat → simple
  3b 'plays ... at the moment' -
     hozir → continuous
  4b 'is watching ... every weekend'
     - odat → simple
  5a 'cooks ... at the moment' -
     hozir → continuous
  6a 'phones ... right now' - hozir
     → continuous


⚠ 'TO DRIVE SB TO SCHOOL':

  = birovni maktabga mashinada
  olib bormoq.


⚠ 'TO PHONE SB':

  = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq ('phone TO'
  EMAS!).

exercises.explanationUz:
USUALLY (simple) vs TODAY
  (continuous).

  QOLIP:
  X usually + V-S ..., but today
  he/she IS + V-ING ... .


RASMLAR:

  1 Kim: nonushta → sport zalida
    gantel ko'taryapti
  2 Paul: soqol olyapti → mashina
    yuvyapti
  3 Karen: velosipedda → taksiga
    chiqyapti


⚠ 'TO HAVE A SHAVE':

  = soqol olmoq. 'have' + ot.
  ⚠ 'to shave' fe'li ham bor.


⚠ 'TO WORK OUT':

  = sport zalida mashq qilmoq.
  'at the gym' = sport zalida.


⚠ 'TO CYCLE':

  = velosipedda yurmoq.
  'cycle TO work' = ishga velosipedda.


⚠ 'TO TAKE A TAXI':

  = taksiga chiqmoq ('take' bilan).
  ⚠ 'take a bus/train/taxi'.


⚠ 3-ShAXS: has, cycles.
  'have' → 'has' (noqonuniy!).

items.textEn: Kim usually has breakfast at 8:00 on Saturday morning, but today she ___ .
items.answer: is working out at the gym
items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA ('has breakfast' berilgan). 'today' → CONTINUOUS: 'is working out at the gym'.

items.textEn: Paul usually ___ after breakfast, but today he ___ .
items.answer: has a shave / is washing the car

items.textEn: Karen usually ___ in the morning, but today she ___ .
items.answer: cycles to work / is taking a taxi to work
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'usually' → 'cycles to work' (simple).
⚠ 'today' → 'is taking a taxi to work' (continuous).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the sentences to complete the dialogue: Really? Where in Spain? / Julio? How do you spell that? / Yes, it is. / Yes, I do. It's lovely.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplar bilan dialogni to'ldiring: Really? Where in Spain? / Julio? How do you spell that? / Yes, it is. / Yes, I do. It's lovely.
exercises.explanationUz:
TANIShUV DIALOGI (coursebook
  11-bet 29-30-mashqlar).

  ⚠ Har javob OLDINGI savolga mos
  kelishi kerak:

  'Is this your first day?' →
    'Yes, it IS.' (is → is)
  'My name's Julio.' →
    'Julio? How do you SPELL that?'
    → 'J-U-L-I-O'
  'I'm from Spain.' →
    'Really? WHERE in Spain?' →
    'Barcelona'
  'DO you like it here?' →
    'Yes, I DO. It's lovely.'


⚠ 'HOW DO YOU SPELL THAT?':

  = Buni qanday yoziladi (harflab)?
  'to spell' = harflab aytmoq.


⚠ 'REALLY?':

  = Rostdanmi? - qiziqish bildirish.


⚠ 'LOVELY':

  = ajoyib, yoqimli (Brit.).


⚠ QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Is ...? → Yes, it is.
  Do ...? → Yes, I do.
  ⚠ Savoldagi yordamchi fe'l
  javobda takrorlanadi.
